tool.name: Open Agent
tool.description: Create a new draft agent (provide name + role; optional description/model/settings) or open an existing agent by slug on the current starship. Returns a lean agent summary (no blueprint/state).

name.description: Human-readable name (required when creating a new agent)

role.description: Human-readable role label for the agent (required when creating a new agent)

slug.description: For opening existing agents only. Do not include when creating; server generates a unique slug.

model.description: LLM model ID from List Models (prefer paid Anthropic models, then OpenAI, then others)

description.description: Optional description (used only when creating a new agent)

systemPrompt.description: System instructions for the agent. Must begin with <character name="AGENT_NAME">ROLE</character> as the first line (name + role only).

previewPrompts.description: Optional example prompts to show in chat (max 10)

nodes.name: Prepare Request
nodes.description: Build URL, headers and body based on mode (create or open)

nodes.name: Route Mode
nodes.description: Route to create vs open based on prepare.mode

nodes.name: Create Agent (Starships)
nodes.description: POST /agents via Starships connector endpoint catalog

nodes.name: Get Agent (Starships)
nodes.description: GET /starships/:starshipId/agents/:slug via Starships connector endpoint catalog

nodes.name: Unwrap
nodes.description: Return body.data/body.error where applicable; otherwise return body/resp

nodes.name: Slim Agent
nodes.description: Return a lean agent summary (omit blueprint/state and internal metadata)
